title: Agora Health Voice
tagline: Explore voice access to health and fitness data through reusable provider adapters.
description: Ask about sleep, heart rate, steps, distance and recent activities through authenticated tool calls. This TypeScript reference implementation pairs Agora Conversational AI Main v2, ARES STT, Agora-managed GPT-4o-mini and Murf Falcon TTS with a shared health-data provider interface: synthetic data is the default and powers the demo, and Garmin Personal API is the first validated live reference integration.
author: Ranga Jagannath

media.demoNote: Recorded demo uses synthetic data. Running voice sessions requires Node.js 24+, Agora Conversational AI Main v2 access, Murf credentials and an HTTPS callback origin. Garmin credentials are needed only for the optional live provider.
